tokens.v: The kraft pouch stands on the rail of a fire-lookout tower at sunrise beside an enamel pot mid-pour into a tin mug, steam whipping sideways in the cold while a sea of valley fog glows amber far below. 35mm at f/4 at rail height, the pour's ribbon sharp, the pouch's roll-top creased down and AMBLE reading in large clean capitals on the wrapped kraft label. The tower's weathered handrail runs out both side edges; a folded wool blanket blurs in the near-left corner, cut by the edge, and the fog sea dissolves to the horizon out the top of the frame.
